record.context_brief: Labelings of C_{4m+2} x P_{2n+1} grids
record.original_question: For positive integers m and n, determine whether the Cartesian-product grid graph C_{4m+2} x P_{2n+1} admits each of the following three labelings: an a-valuation, a graceful labeling, and a harmonious labeling. Here P_r is the path with r vertices, C_r is the cycle with r vertices, and G x H is the Cartesian product graph whose vertices are ordered pairs and whose edges join pairs that agree in one coordinate and are adjacent in the other. A graceful labeling of a connected graph with e edges assigns distinct vertex labels from 0 through e so that the absolute differences on edges are exactly 1 through e; an a-valuation is a graceful labeling with a threshold separating the endpoint labels of every edge; a harmonious labeling assigns distinct vertex labels from 0 through e - 1 so that edge sums are distinct modulo e.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $P_r$ denote the path graph on $r$ vertices and $C_r$ the cycle graph on $r$ vertices. For graphs $G$ and $H$, the Cartesian product $G \square H$ has vertex set $V(G) \times V(H)$, with two vertices $(u_1,v_1)$ and $(u_2,v_2)$ adjacent if and only if either $u_1 = u_2$ and $v_1v_2 \in E(H)$, or $v_1 = v_2$ and $u_1u_2 \in E(G)$.

For a connected graph $G$ with $e$ edges:
(i) A graceful labeling is an injection $f: V(G) \to \{0, 1, \ldots, e\}$ such that the induced edge labels $\{|f(u) - f(v)| : uv \in E(G)\}$ equal $\{1, 2, \ldots, e\}$.
(ii) An $\alpha$-valuation is a graceful labeling $f$ for which there exists an integer $k$ with $\min\{f(u), f(v)\} \le k < \max\{f(u), f(v)\}$ for every edge $uv \in E(G)$.
(iii) A harmonious labeling is an injection $g: V(G) \to \mathbb{Z}/e\mathbb{Z}$ such that the induced edge labels $\{g(u) + g(v) \pmod{e} : uv \in E(G)\}$ are all distinct (and hence form $\mathbb{Z}/e\mathbb{Z}$).

For all positive integers $m$ and $n$, determine whether the grid-like graph $C_{4m+2} \square P_{2n+1}$ admits (a) an $\alpha$-valuation, (b) a graceful labeling, and (c) a harmonious labeling.
artifact.status_search_result: Gallian's dynamic survey of graph labeling lists labelings of prism-like products $C_m \square P_n$ as a long-standing area with several unresolved cases. The specific instance $C_{4m+2} \square P_{2n+1}$ — covering gracefulness, $\alpha$-valuation, and harmonious labeling — is recorded as unresolved, with no published constructions or non-existence proofs found that settle all three questions for general $m$ and $n$.

status_evidence.title: A Dynamic Survey of Graph Labeling (Gallian)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing known and open cases of graceful, alpha, and harmonious labelings of products C_m x P_n.
status_evidence.claim: Several cases of C_m x P_n labelings remain open in the survey's tables.

status_evidence.title: Graceful labeling for grid related graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses graceful labelings of grid and cycle-of-grid graphs without resolving C_{4m+2} x P_{2n+1}.
status_evidence.claim: No general resolution given for the C_{4m+2} x P_{2n+1} family.
